environment.pdf: Chromium Skia A4; Poppler text extraction

design.objective: Carry a complete inspectable project handover to print/PDF without manually traversing paginated reading panels.
design.baseline_verified: Inspected baseline print CSS and twenty-item reader pagination: only currently displayed work/results/context print, with an explicit incomplete-print notice.
design.selection_reason: A reproducible omission directly prevents an existing portable record workflow from reaching paper/PDF in full.
design.result: On-demand complete preview and beforeprint report ignore reading filters/pages, preserve source decision references and ordered historical revisions, and return to unchanged reading state.

Missing action data/history explicitly disclosed; return controls work.
